draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Loutolim! Legend says this village was founded by Brahmins from northern India who came to Goa after the Saraswati River in their homeland dried up. Today it's home to Big Foot, a museum that recreates old rural Goa in miniature.
draft.hungryLine: No eateries in my notes for Loutolim, so plan a meal in Margao, about 10 km away.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Big Foot Museum is just a 3 minute walk away, a whole Goan village recreated in miniature.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Head toward the Zuari, which flows along one side of the village.
moodReplies.surprise-me: In 1567 the captain of Rachol Fort ordered the village temples destroyed, and some villagers carried the idol of Shri Ramnath across the Zuari to safety.

spots.name: Big Foot Museum
spots.detail: 3 min walk · Artist Maendra Alvares's recreation of old Goan village life

spots.name: Ashvek Vintage World
spots.detail: In Nuvem · Restored vintage cars, from Mercedes Benz to Morris and Volkswagen

legends.title: Settlers from the Saraswati
legends.body: The village story goes that Brahmins from northern India founded Loutolim. They moved to Goa after the Saraswati River in their homeland dried up.

tips.title: Pair it with Margao.
tips.body: Loutolim is only about 10 km from Margao, so it makes an easy half-day trip.

tips.title: Bring a little cash.
tips.body: Ashvek Vintage World in nearby Nuvem charges a small entry fee of about Rs 50.

story.title: A village from the north
story.body: According to legend, Brahmins from northern India founded Loutolim after the Saraswati River dried up.

story.title: Temples destroyed
story.body: Diogo Rodrigues, captain of Rachol Fort, ordered the village temples burnt. Some Hindus fled across the Zuari with their idols, including Shri Ramnath.

story.title: A Jesuit church
story.body: The Jesuits built the Salvador do Mundo church in 1586 for local converts.

story.title: Old Goa in miniature
story.body: Loutolim is a large Salcete village, and the Big Foot Museum keeps Goa's rural past alive.
